response.justification: Bogdan brings valuable geospatial domain expertise through GISCollective and prior work, plus relevant distributed systems experience from Dunnhumby. However, he has a critical gap in the primary requirement: modern C++ development. His last significant C++ work was in 2014-2015, and his recent 1.5 years have focused on TypeScript/Node.js and AI infrastructure at re:cinq. He has no Rust experience. While his proven polyglot abilities and systems-level programming background (D language) suggest he could eventually learn C++, this represents a training commitment rather than an immediate fit for a senior role requiring modern systems programming expertise.
strengths: Strong geospatial domain expertise through GISCollective (open-source geo-data platform), FOSS4G 2019 presentation, and Green Map work—directly relevant to routing tile systems
Proven systems-level programming experience with low-latency, high-performance distributed systems at Dunnhumby handling millions of requests/second using async I/O and optimization techniques
Polyglot engineer with demonstrated ability to learn languages and technologies rapidly, showing willingness to expand expertise across technical stacks as required by the role
concerns: No modern C++ development experience—last significant C++ work was at National Instruments in 2014-2015; primary languages over the past decade have been TypeScript, Node.js, and D
No Rust experience despite Rust being listed as an acceptable alternative to C++ for this role
Recent professional focus (past 1.5 years) on web/full-stack and AI infrastructure diverts from systems-level programming expertise needed for data pipeline and tile optimization work
